title: Ions
definition: An ion is an atom or molecule in which the total number of electrons is not equal to the total number of protons, giving it a net positive or negative electrical charge.
importanceInUpsc: Essential for Physics and Chemistry modules under General Science in UPSC Prelims (concepts of electrochemistry, ionization, cosmic rays, ionosphere) and Science & Technology applications (lithium-ion batteries, plasma physics).
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Ions.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
